t: Browser Acetate: A No-Gooey Methodology for 9:16 Screen Recordings
s: This article presents a 'No-Gooey' methodology for creating 9:16 screen recordings by using a browser-based HTML/CSS overlay to define the safe zone, ensuring consistent framing across different OS resolutions and minimizing post-production effort.
sub: Resolution-independent 9:16 framing using CSS viewport units.
Browser overlay technique for 'always-on-top' but non-modal screen layout guidance.
Post-production cropping strategy with MoviePy for 9:16 aspect ratio.
Workflow optimization for vertical video platforms (TikTok, YouTube Shorts).
